cooldown: ability used at turnT with cooldownC available again at T+C+1; charge turn does not start cooldown; release does
STUN: prevents all actions including potion, guard and item; consume at next owner action boundary
SILENCE: prevents active skill/talisman; permits basic attack/guard/potion
SLOW: effective SPD*0.85 (status table), replaces old fixed12SPD demo shortcut
duration: 1-turn control survives until affected actor action or skipped action; never disappears before that actor can be affected
doubled_status: same group refresh longest duration,DoT max2 stacks; all DoT combined under3%maxHP/roundPvE or8%PvP
phase_buff_recompute: modifiers use immutable base every round; do not multiply current stats repeatedly
reflect: does not reflect reflected damage; cap5%player maxHP per hit; absorbed shield damage does not count
equipment: apply typed equip effects once from base loadout, then timed buffs, then global caps
quality: only quality_scalable operations multiply1/1.05/1.10/1.15; no scaling progress,breakthrough,permanent stat,duration
talisman: one shared use per actor/battle, PvE only; consumption occurs when action actually commits
control_boss: STUN/SILENCE targeting boss converts to SLOW
lethal: death on HP0;LưỡngSinh excludes tribulation and PvP; same atomic battle/death/escrow lifecycle handler
timeout: UNRESOLVED_TIMEOUT retains battle/life; not an automatic escape or refund
